references.source: U. Ghia, K.N. Ghia & C.T. Shin, 'High-Re solutions for incompressible flow using the Navier-Stokes equations and a multigrid method', J. Comput. Phys. 48 (1982) 387-411, Re = 100 column; table values as transcribed in https://github.com/pypr/pysph/blob/master/pysph/examples/ghia_cavity_data.py; Table I (u on x = 0.5), y = 0.4531
references.notes: Ghia et al.: finite-difference stream function-vorticity multigrid solution on a uniform grid (129 x 129 for Re = 100, from memory); grid-point values to 5 decimals. The table is 1.4% smaller in magnitude than the mesh-converged value -0.21392 of the fixed solver (OpenFOAM, Richardson-extrapolated 32/64/128 study, GCI <= 0.25 %), consistent with fine-grid literature (Sahin & Owens 2003); the tolerance covers that table error plus the agent's discretization error. See docs/benchmarks_cfd.md.
